name: You.com

overview.text: You.com presents search and inference infrastructure. Its documentation limits keyless machine payments to Web Search and Finance Research, not every API; Contents and the separate Research API require a key. Listed Web Search prices are $0.005 through x402 in USDC on Base or Solana, versus $0.01 through MPP on Tempo. Finance Research is $0.11 deep or $0.50 exhaustive on either rail. Livecrawl adds $0.001 per requested result, with MPP rounding up to whole cents, so returned terms govern the actual request. Cards and fiat are not enabled on these rails, and keyless requests do not receive Zero Data Retention.
